verdict.rationale: Airweave documents self-hosting via `./start.sh` on macOS/Linux/WSL, showing you can run the platform's infrastructure locally, but there's no evidence about running fully embedded in-process or against local embedding/LLM models without any external API calls (e.g., OpenAI) — the docs never address model provider configuration or offline/no-cloud-dependency mode. missing for 10: documentation of local/offline model configuration, evidence that vector search and agentic search work without calling external cloud LLM/embedding APIs, confirmation of an embedded in-process mode.
